description: Ordinary non-confidential public-cloud CPU capacity, including spot and preemptible instances, used as one replica of an N-way independent replication. There is no SEV-SNP guest, no vTPM quote, and no attestation service in this path: a single run on this target is an unattested local record. Only agreement between independently operated replicas carries evidential weight, and that weight is the operational independence of the operators, not a hardware root of trust.
